symbols.name: calculateBattlePassPoints

symbols.name: canAcquireInvokerWeapon
symbols.doc: Separate spell weapons require Invoke in the same inventory, and hero must be allowed to acquire.

symbols.name: canCharacterAcquireWeapon
symbols.doc: The single source of truth for whether a hero is allowed to acquire or upgrade a weapon. Rules: 1. If weapon is exclusive to hero X, only hero X can acquire it. 2. If hero is a unique character (e.g. Invoker): - They can only acquire weapons from their exclusive list. - They CANNOT acquire generic weapons (bow, katana, etc.) unless allowGenericWeapons is explicitly true. - Sub-prerequisites (like having invoker_invoke) are evaluated. 3. If hero is a non-unique character (Ronin, Valkyrie, Archer, etc.): - They CANNOT acquire any exclusive weapon (like invoker_invoke or any invoker spell). - They can acquire any generic non-exclusive weapon.

symbols.name: canRerollWeaponOptions

symbols.name: MainMenuScreen
symbols.doc: Modular Main Menu Screen (Dark ARPG Rift UI). Coordinates singleplayer start, multiplayer lobby, quests toggle, talents shop, settings, and exit.

symbols.name: MapManager.renderCenterSquareMap
symbols.doc: Renders the square full-world interactive overlay map (Diablo / PoE TAB style). Displays all 10x10 chunks across the 500x500 world bounds without bezel or round border. Shrouds unexplored chunks in Fog of War (туман войны). Displays all discovered altars, teleporter, chests, bosses, teammates, and player.

symbols.name: MapManager.renderFullMap
symbols.doc: Renders the full-screen vintage parchment surveyor map (TAB).

symbols.name: MapManager.renderMinimap
symbols.doc: Renders the real-time circular Minimap in the corner of the screen.

symbols.name: matchesSearch
symbols.doc: Smart search filter for balance entities. Supports fuzzy matching across: - Entity Names & IDs (Russian and English) - Descriptions, Notes, Roles - Exact and partial numeric values (e.g. '2.5', '100', '0.4') - Property keys (e.g. 'cooldown', 'damage', 'hp', 'radius')

symbols.name: MeleeAttackEffects
symbols.doc: Bounded, reusable effects for both local attacks and relayed co-op attacks.

symbols.name: MeleeAttackInfo
symbols.doc: Cosmetic attack data; never participates in damage or collision checks.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.createRoom
symbols.doc: Host creates a new multiplayer room for up to 5 players.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.generateRoomCode
symbols.doc: Generates a 6-character memorable Western room code like "WEST-48" or "COLT-72"

symbols.name: NetworkManager.handleIncomingGuestConnection
symbols.doc: Host handles a new guest connecting.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.joinRoom
symbols.doc: Guest joins an existing room by code.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.send
symbols.doc: Broadcasts a network message across active channels (WebRTC and/or BroadcastChannel). Host snapshots are automatically packed into compact binary ArrayBuffers.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.sendToPeer
symbols.doc: Sends a targeted message to a specific peer or host.

symbols.name: NetworkManager.setPassword
symbols.doc: Sets or clears room password on an active host.

symbols.name: ObstacleManager.addObstacle
symbols.doc: Registers an obstacle under a chunk key (spatially hashed by obstacle world position).

symbols.name: ObstacleManager.clear
symbols.doc: Clears all obstacles (for game restart).

symbols.name: ObstacleManager.getObstaclesForChunkKey
symbols.doc: Returns list of obstacles registered for a chunk key.

symbols.name: ObstacleManager.removeChunkObstacles
symbols.doc: Removes all obstacles belonging to an unloaded chunk.

symbols.name: packHostSnapshot
symbols.doc: Packs a HostSnapshotMessage into an ultra-compact binary ArrayBuffer. Reduces bandwidth from ~45 KB (JSON) down to ~2-3 KB!

symbols.name: Player.gainXp
symbols.doc: onLevelGained queues upgrades; the returned count is for visual feedback only.

symbols.name: Player.getDamageMultiplier
symbols.doc: Calculates effective damage multiplier for a given weapon. Per rule: initial hero damage bonus applies ONLY to their starting weapon! Other weapons receive 1.0  general bonuses (passive damage, altars, buffs, cheats, energy amplifier, void catalyst).

symbols.name: Player.getNaniteDamageReduction
symbols.doc: Calculates damage reduction provided by Nanite Plating (Нано-Броня). Level 1 gives 5%, diminishing returns up to 60% at level 20, capped at 60%.

symbols.name: PlayerAnimation
symbols.doc: Handles sprite direction, sheet animations (IDLE, WALK, ATTACK), texture loading, and damage/status color tints for players. Uses unified CharacterAnimator for all character types.

symbols.name: PlayerMotor
symbols.doc: Handles physics, movement calculations, terrain interactions, tactical dash mechanics, and map boundary constraints for the Player.

symbols.name: PlayerStats
symbols.doc: Encapsulates RPG stat computation, passive bonus scaling, dimishing returns, Rift item multipliers, and XP level progression.

symbols.name: PoisonPuddleWeapon

symbols.name: RiftTeleporter
symbols.doc: 2.5D Dimensional Rift (Разлом) for biome transitions. - Closed state: Dark ominous cosmic tear in reality, pulsating with dark eldritch veins. - On touch or interaction [E]: The boss emerges from the rift and the portal opens. - Open state: Radiant glowing interdimensional gateway with swirling celestial vortex. - Sized 8.0 units with contact shadow and directional shadow casting. - Warp transition to next biome triggers ONLY via interaction prompt [E].

symbols.name: RiftTeleporter.disableForFinalStage
symbols.doc: Disables the teleporter for the final stage (Rift Core) where no transitions occur.

symbols.name: RiftTeleporter.resetForStage
symbols.doc: Resets teleporter for a new stage at new random location.

symbols.name: RiftTeleporter.stabilizeVoluntaryPortal
symbols.doc: Automatically stabilizes the teleporter when 5 minutes on the biome have elapsed.

symbols.name: rollChestDropPair
symbols.doc: Rolls two distinct item drops from a chest (no duplicates allowed). Filters out items whose parameters are already maxed out for the player.

symbols.name: rollRiftItem
symbols.doc: Legacy weights roller kept for backwards compatibility.

symbols.name: rollRiftItemByStage
symbols.doc: Rolls an item drop based on stage/biome probabilities. Filters out items whose parameters are already maxed out for the player.

symbols.name: RoughTerrainManager.clear
symbols.doc: Cleans up all zones and materials.

symbols.name: RoughTerrainManager.getSlowFactor
symbols.doc: Fast O(1) query returning speed multiplier (0.65 if in rough terrain/dune, 1.0 otherwise).

symbols.name: RoughTerrainManager.isSlowed
symbols.doc: Returns true if given world coordinate is inside any dune / rough zone.

symbols.name: SafeDOM
symbols.doc: SafeDOM utility for resilient UI interaction. Prevents application-wide crashes when elements are renamed, removed, or missing in HTML templates.

symbols.name: ScreenManager

symbols.name: SeededRNG
symbols.doc: Deterministic PRNG using the Mulberry32 algorithm with string hashing support. Guarantees 100% reproducible world generation across all clients and game sessions.

symbols.name: SeededRNG.hashString
symbols.doc: Fast, reliable FNV-1a 32-bit hash function for string seeds.

symbols.name: SeededRNG.next
symbols.doc: Generates a deterministic float in range [0, 1)

symbols.name: SeededRNG.range
symbols.doc: Generates a deterministic float in range [min, max)

symbols.name: SeededRNG.rangeInt
symbols.doc: Generates a deterministic integer in range [min, max] inclusive

symbols.name: selectWeaponUpgradeOptions
symbols.doc: The pool is already shuffled and filtered for ownership, prerequisites and weapon slots.

symbols.name: SessionDirector.activateRift
symbols.doc: Activates the dimensional rift: summons the stage boss directly from the rift and opens the portal into its luminous radiant state.

symbols.name: SessionDirector.canTeleportToRift
symbols.doc: Checks whether the player is allowed to teleport to the dimensional rift. Teleport is available only after the teleporter is opened (state !== 'IDLE') and provided the player is at least two squares (100 meters) away from it.

symbols.name: SessionDirector.resumeSavedRun
symbols.doc: Resumes a previously saved run from localStorage.

symbols.name: SessionDirector.saveCurrentRunAndExit
symbols.doc: Serializes current run state and returns to Main Menu ("Доиграть позднее").

symbols.name: SessionDirector.teleportPlayerToRift
symbols.doc: Teleports player instantly to the Rift portal with sulfur smoke effects, granting a 1.5s invulnerability shield and advancing game & stage time by 20s. Available strictly after the rift is opened and when at least 2 squares away.

symbols.name: SpatialGrid
symbols.doc: High-performance 2D Spatial Hash Grid for entity collisions, separation, and projectile hit-testing. Replaces O(N^2) double-loops with O(N) localized neighborhood searches, eliminating CPU stutter when monster counts scale up to hundreds of entities.

symbols.name: SpatialGrid.queryRadius
symbols.doc: Fast query for nearby enemies within a circular radius. Reuses an output array to eliminate GC pressure.

symbols.name: SpatialGrid.resolveSeparation
symbols.doc: O(N) soft separation using cell neighborhood pairs. Every potentially overlapping pair is evaluated exactly once without allocations.

symbols.name: SpellControlState
symbols.doc: Countdown state shared by the browser and dedicated simulation.

symbols.name: SulfurSmokeManager
symbols.doc: Global manager for Brimstone / Sulfur Smoke teleport and disappearance effects.

symbols.name: SulfurSmokeVfxInstance
symbols.doc: Individual instance of the Brimstone Smoke cloud VFX. Plays sequential 6-frame animation with initial bright light burst followed by expanding and dissipating violet-black / dark blue sulfur smoke.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation
symbols.doc: Procedural Terrain Elevation Generator. Provides deterministic, continuous, multi-octave height and analytical normals for the 500x500 meter game world.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.getElevation
symbols.doc: Returns flat ground elevation Y = 0 to preserve 2D/2.5D pixel-art plane consistency.

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.getNormal
symbols.doc: Returns flat ground normal (0, 1, 0).

symbols.name: TerrainElevation.setSeed
symbols.doc: Reconfigures harmonic parameters based on seed for varied topography per stage.

symbols.name: TerrainMaterials
symbols.doc: Reusable shared materials for high performance and low draw overhead

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createOasis
symbols.doc: Builds an expansive desert oasis landmark with turquoise pool, wet sand shoreline, perimeter palm trees, smooth river stones and reeds. Player and enemies cannot enter the water (solid collision registered via ObstacleManager).

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createPalmTree
symbols.doc: Builds an authentic desert palm tree with curved segmented trunk, radiating fronds and coconuts.

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createScrub

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createSteerSkull

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createTrailPost

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createTree

symbols.name: TerrainProps.createWagonWheel
symbols.doc: Builds an abandoned wooden wagon wheel half-buried in the sand.

symbols.name: TextureManager.createShadowMesh

symbols.name: TextureManager.preloadAll

symbols.name: TreeManager.createTreeMesh

symbols.name: UIEventBus

symbols.name: UNIQUE_CHARACTERS

symbols.name: unpackHostSnapshot
symbols.doc: Unpacks an ArrayBuffer back into a complete HostSnapshotMessage object.

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI
symbols.doc: Handles the visual presentation of the game update notification. Designed to be non-intrusive (never pauses the game, doesn't capture gameplay keystrokes, auto-collapses during combat, and re-expands when the run finishes).

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.onRunEnded
symbols.doc: Called when player dies, wins, or returns to main menu (peaceful phase). Re-expands the banner with a run-completion reminder.

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.preventFocusLoss
symbols.doc: Prevents UI buttons from capturing keyboard focus (e.g. Space to dash, WASD to move).

symbols.name: UpdateNotificationUI.setCombatActive
symbols.doc: Called by Game / HUD when entering gameplay.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier
symbols.doc: UpdateNotifier checks for new client builds/patches deployed to the host. Emits non-intrusive notifications when an update is available without disrupting active gameplay.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.applyUpdate
symbols.doc: Applies update by clearing caches and reloading page.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.init
symbols.doc: Initializes polling and listeners.

symbols.name: UpdateNotifier.simulateUpdate
symbols.doc: Simulates an update event (useful for UI testing and verification in Dev mode).
